worldAppId.label: World app ID
worldAppId.helpText: Public app_id from the World Developer Portal. Configure privately with Devvit settings.

worldRpId.label: World relying-party ID
worldRpId.helpText: Public rp_id from the World Developer Portal. Configure privately with Devvit settings.

worldHumanBadgeAction.label: Proof of Human badge action
worldHumanBadgeAction.helpText: World action used for the optional Orb-backed human badge. Defaults to the Selfie Check action for the POC.

worldRpSigningKey.label: World RP signing key
worldRpSigningKey.helpText: Server-only signing key from the World Developer Portal.

signalHmacSecret.label: Opaque signal HMAC secret
signalHmacSecret.helpText: Server-only random secret used to derive unlinkable World signals.

worldBridgeBaseUrl.label: Verification bridge base URL
worldBridgeBaseUrl.helpText: HTTPS origin of the separately hosted bridge. Add its exact hostname to permissions.http.domains before upload.

worldBridgeApiToken.label: Verification bridge API token
worldBridgeApiToken.helpText: Shared server-to-server token; must equal BRIDGE_API_TOKEN on the bridge.

humanBadgeFlairText.label: Orb-verified human badge flair
humanBadgeFlairText.helpText: Uses the unique_human custom emoji uploaded to the subreddit.

items.label: Open Orb Human Badge portal
items.description: Create or open the community's Orb badge entry point.
